items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Known compatibility evidence is limited to these checks: Tightbeam CLI 0.1.16 and Gateway 0.1.16 (build 4283) roster output contained the required string fields; a pre-recovery Tuner Debug build opened a conversation, sent one prompt, and displayed the reply with Chat v0.1.100. That conversation check predates the recovery change. The recovery change has not been exercised with Chat v0.1.101, and Tuner's in-app SSH roster fetch was not exercised.
